page_title: NEW 1-1 MCI | Newcastle v Manchester City 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester City.

90+5' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Nick Pope, who pulls off a comfortable save!
90+3' The resulting corner from Phil Foden (Manchester City) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

90+2' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the left side of the goal. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save! Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jarred Gillett had an easy-decision to make.
89' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Newcastle.
87' The current number of shots on goal is 4:4.
83' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
83' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
81' The manager makes a subsitution with Savinho (Manchester City) coming on for Rico Lewis.
81' That's the end of the game for Jack Grealish, who is replaced by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
78' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Kieran Trippier is replaced by Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd).
78' Substitution. Sandro Tonali walks off the pitch and Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) comes on as a substitute.
77' We are about to witness a substitution. Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) is replacing Harvey Barnes.
76' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
76' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
73' Ball possession – 38:62.
69' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
66' A substitution has been made. Ilkay Gundogan is replaced by Phil Foden (Manchester City).
63' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
62' The referee is firm and issues Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) a deserved yellow card.
62' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Jack Grealish (Manchester City) is given a yellow card.
62' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.

61' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Ederson anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
60' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
58' 1 - 1 Goal! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Ederson into left side of the goal.
57' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is going to take the penalty!
57' PENALTY to Newcastle! Great chance to score. Ederson (Manchester City) brings an opponent down and Jarred Gillett interrupts the game.
56' Ederson (Manchester City) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
55' Manchester City are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
53' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
51' One of the Newcastle players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
50' A cross into the box from Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is cleared.
48' Manchester City control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Jarred Gillett has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.

45+2' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Ederson. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

44' This shall not pass! Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner.

40' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Nick Pope!
40' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
38' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner.
35' 0 - 1 Goal! Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Jack Grealish, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
32' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
29' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

29' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Manchester City force their opponents to concede a corner.

27' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
26' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
26' Corner kick. Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is ready to send the ball into the box.
25' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
25' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
23' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 38:62.
20' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
18' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) commits a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
15' The corner from Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is hurriedly cleared.
15' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Newcastle get a corner.
15' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes.
12' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
9' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
7' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Nick Pope, who makes a comfortable save.
6' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
5' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

4' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester City.

3' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jarred Gillett blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
2' Manchester City enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett will officiate today.
